Awesome-Agent-Memory.name: memgres
Awesome-Agent-Memory.desc: Versioned document memory for AI agents over one Postgres; lexical or semantic recall, diff-based history, git-blame line attribution, GDPR-erasable, multi-tenant via MCP/HTTP.
